title: NBA.com/Stats Frequently Asked Questions
method: Primary page read through page-fetch tool
quote: Our stats are not available for download for either academic or personal use.
supports: Access limitation; no bulk scraping or licensed-feed claim. Small factual score extracts are separately linked to their official pages.

title: Rule No. 5: Scoring and Timing
method: Primary page read through page-fetch tool
quote: All periods of regulation play in the NBA will be twelve minutes.
supports: Regulation duration; the same page specifies five-minute overtime periods. This is not a sportsbook settlement rule.

title: Stat Glossary
method: Primary page read through page-fetch tool
supports: Official terminology reference. Model features and PRA arithmetic are defined by this project, not official sportsbook lines.

title: Basketball Rules
method: Both primary page chunks read through page-fetch tool
quote: All pre-game bets include overtime unless otherwise stated.
supports: Operator-specific settlement context only. The page also requires relevant players to be dressed and see court time, unless specified otherwise. Never generalize to all operators or jurisdictions.

title: What is a Same Game Parlay or SGP Plus?
method: Primary support article read through page-fetch tool
quote: Same game parlays are a type of parlay that combines two or more selections from a single game or correlated games, matches, or events.
supports: Existence and definition of SGP; not a quoted price, eligibility guarantee, or evidence of profitability.

title: Mean Vector and Covariance Matrix
method: Primary reference page read through page-fetch tool
quote: The formula for computing the covariance of the variables X and Y
supports: Sample covariance definition used in Pearson correlation. Does not verify any NBA correlation estimate.

title: Proportion Confidence Interval
method: Primary reference page read through page-fetch tool
quote: This method was originally proposed by Wilson in 1927.
supports: Wilson interval reference; binomial intervals require independent trials and are not used to certify correlated parlays.

title: TimeSeriesSplit
method: Official project documentation read through page-fetch tool
quote: other cross-validation methods are inappropriate, as they would lead to training on future data and evaluating on past data.
supports: Chronological evaluation principle. This project implements its own date-split, not the library estimator.

title: Probability calibration
method: Official project documentation read through page-fetch tool
quote: A lower Brier loss, for instance, does not necessarily mean a better calibrated model
supports: Separate proper scores from calibration diagnostics; no calibration claim from Brier alone.

title: Metrics and scoring: quantifying the quality of predictions
method: Official project documentation read through page-fetch tool
quote: The Brier score is just a different name for the squared error in case of classification with one-hot encoded targets.
supports: Probability score definition, not a sports edge test.

title: ... and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
method: Original working-paper abstract read through page-fetch tool
quote: Our paper introduces a multiple testing framework
supports: Multiple-testing risk; the page discusses a t-ratio above 3 in its financial-factor setting. That cutoff is not transferred to NBA as a validated threshold.

title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality
method: Original paper landing page and abstract read through page-fetch tool
quote: Not controlling for the number of trials involved in a particular discovery leads to over-optimistic performance expectations.
supports: Selection bias and non-normal returns. DSR is not computed here because there are no verified wager return series.

title: Official scoreboards, January 1–8, 2025
method: All eight date pages and all result chunks read; 62 game records transcribed with exact per-date source links
supports: 62 final scores and overtime labels. Display order is retained as team1/team2; home designation is not inferred for the whole sample.

title: Boston Celtics vs Oklahoma City Thunder, January 5, 2025 box score
method: All player-table chunks read; 18 participating-player rows transcribed
supports: Player minutes, points, rebounds and assists; team totals used as arithmetic cross-checks. DNP rows excluded, not converted to zero-stat performances.

title: Brooklyn Nets vs Milwaukee Bucks, January 2, 2025 box score
method: All player-table chunks read; 20 participating-player rows transcribed
supports: Player minutes, points, rebounds and assists; team totals used as arithmetic cross-checks. This is a two-game convenience sample, not a player-time-series panel.
